data.one_liner: A collection of Android and iOS loading indicator GIFs for image placeholders.
data.what_it_does: Provides pre-made Material Design and Cupertino loading indicator GIFs in assorted sizes and variants. It is designed to be used as placeholder images for loading remote image assets like FadeInImage.
use_when: You need standard Material or Cupertino loading indicator placeholders for FadeInImage
You want pre-packaged loading spinner GIFs of various sizes
avoid_when: You prefer using native Flutter widget-based spinners instead of GIF assets
You need customizable vector loading animations
strengths: Includes both Material and Cupertino loading indicator styles
Provides multiple sizes and optimized variants
Includes a transparent 1x1 pixel empty placeholder
weaknesses: Relies on GIF files rather than true vector or widget-based loaders
